interface.longDescription: Installs the user-facing stock_analyzer skill that drives an already deployed DSA checkout or running DSA service (marketplace caches only plugin/, not src/). Skill body: plugin/skills/stock_analyzer/SKILL.md; repo-root SKILL.md is a plain-file copy for OpenClaw and core.symlinks=false. Repo-maintenance skills under .agents/skills are not included. Optional read-only MCP (`python -m src.mcp_server`) remains a checkout-side setup per docs/full-guide.md.
